Class SysMLState

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLAction
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLVertex
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLState
Direct Known Subclasses:
SysMLFinalState
public class SysMLState extends SysMLVertex
The SysMLinJava representation of the state in SysML's state machine. SysMLState should be used as the type of all states in the state machine and should not be extended for further specialization. SysMLState contains the enter, do, and exit activities. In lieu of the do action, the state can contain sub-state machines. As a vertex, the SysMLState includes state transitions which are added by SysMLTransition initializers. An example follows. 
        :
@State
public SysMLState ice;
@State
public SysMLState liquid;
@State
public SysMLState gas;
@State
public SysMLState decomposed;
        :
@Override
protected void createStates()
{
        super.createStates();
        ice = new SysMLState(context, "Ice");
        liquid = new SysMLState(context, "Liquid");
        gas = new SysMLState(context, "Gas");
        decomposed = new SysMLState(context, Optional.of(decomposedOnEnterAction), Optional.empty(), Optional.empty(), "Decomposed");
}

  • Field Details

    • onEnterAction

      public Optional<SysMLEntryActionFunction> onEnterAction
      Optional action to be performed upon entry into the state.

    • doAction

      public Optional<SysMLDoActionFunction> doAction
      Optional action to be performed while in the state. If set, the doAction is executed in lieu of the subStateMachines.

    • onExitAction

      public Optional<SysMLExitActionFunction> onExitAction
      Optional action to be performed upon exiting from the state.

    • subStateMachines

      public List<? extends SysMLStateMachine> subStateMachines
      List collection of state machines to be executed while in the (composite) state. Multiple sub-state machines are executed in parallel, i.e. as concurrent state machines within the context of the current state. The subStateMachines execute in lieu of the doAction, if set.

    • completedSubStateMachineIDs

      public List<Long> completedSubStateMachineIDs
      List collection of IDs of sub-state machines that have submitted StateMachineCompletionEvents to be executed while in the (composite) state. Used to determine when all sub-state machines have completed, i.e. have transitioned to their final states.

    • containingStateMachine

      public Optional<? extends SysMLStateMachine> containingStateMachine
      Optional state machine that contains this state. The containingStateMachine is required if there are any subStateMachines and the stateMachine of context will be used by default, but this value can be set to another stateMachine as needed.

    • doActionFuture

      public Optional<Future<?>> doActionFuture
      Optional Future for the doAction which runs in a separate thread while in the current state. This future is used to stop the doAction if/when exit out of the current state is triggered.

    • doActionExecutor

      public Optional<ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor> doActionExecutor
      Optional ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor for the doAction which runs the separate thread while in the current state.

  • Method Details

    • subStateMachinesCompleted

      public boolean subStateMachinesCompleted(SysMLCompletionEvent completionEvent)
      Returns whether or not receipt of the specified completion event means that all sub-state machines have now completed.
      Parameters:
      completionEvent - completion event presumably just received from one of the sub-state machines
      Returns:
      true if all sub-state machines are now completed, false otherwise

    • onEnter

      public void onEnter()
      Operation called upon entry into the state. onEnter() invokes the specified (onEnterAction, if provided. Also, if they are present, all sub-state machines are executed (started)

    • doWhileInState

      public void doWhileInState()
      Action to be performed while in the state. doWhileInState() invokes the specified doAction, if provided, performing the action in a separate thread of execution.

    • onExit

      public void onExit()
      Operation called upon exit from the state. onExit() invokes the specified onExitAction, if provided, but only after it terminates the doAction, if present and started, or terminates the sub-state machines, if present.

    • executeSubStateMachines

      private void executeSubStateMachines()
      Executes (starts) all of the sub-state machines that have been added to this state

    • terminateSubStateMachines

      private void terminateSubStateMachines()
      Terminates (stops) all of the sub-state machines that have been added to this state.
